alerts.title: Coding has the largest unmet-demand index
alerts.detail: Needed in 16.3% of analytics postings while juniors average 4.27/5, so demand-weighted headroom is largest here (index 24).

alerts.title: Dashboards & Storytelling separates high performers
alerts.detail: Juniors with high salary hikes score 4.85 vs 3.81 on Dashboards & Storytelling (r=0.55), the strongest link of all five skills.
actions: Agencies: add projects that train it
Recruiters: weigh it in junior screening

alerts.title: Conscientiousness and Openness predict senior success
alerts.detail: Successful seniors average 53.68 vs 35.74 on Conscientiousness and 48.49 vs 33.32 on Openness. Neuroticism shows almost no link (r=-0.01).
actions: Recruiters: assess these traits for client-facing roles
Agencies: add soft-skill and ownership training

alerts.title: Big Data is the weakest predictor of salary hikes
alerts.detail: Only r=0.11 with salary hikes (junior cohort mean 3.85/5), despite heavy demand for it in job postings.
actions: Students: do not neglect it, but prioritise stronger levers first
Agencies: pair it with practical projects

alerts.title: Bengaluru dominates analytics hiring
alerts.detail: 25.8% of postings mention Bengaluru, followed by Mumbai (16.5%) and Gurgaon (13.1%).
actions: Students: target these hubs or remote roles
Recruiters: expect competition for talent there

alerts.title: Most postings pay 10–25 lakh
actions: Students: senior-level skills unlock the 25L+ band
Recruiters: benchmark offers against these bands

callouts.STUDENT: Learn SQL, Python, Data Analysis first: they appear most in postings. Then raise Dashboards & Storytelling, the strongest link to salary hikes among juniors.
callouts.RECRUITER: Screen juniors on Dashboards & Storytelling and Maths & Stats, and seniors on Conscientiousness and Openness. Competition is highest in Bengaluru.
callouts.COURSE_AGENCY: Teach Coding first (gap index 24), build projects around Dashboards & Storytelling, and cover SQL, Python, Data Analysis.
